title: 0.2.16 P0 hardening and safer OTA
summary: This update finishes the first P0 hardening wave: safer OTA checks, rollback protection, large-file upload streaming, launcher recovery, and more robust history/plugin handling.
highlights: OTA release packages now support SHA256 metadata and the updater verifies the package before applying it.
Updates refuse silent downgrades by default and roll back failed git updates to the previous revision.
Runtime file synchronization preserves local history, user plugins, local config and user-dropped files instead of deleting them.
The launcher can recover from abandoned single-instance locks, rotates launcher logs, and reports startup failures visibly.
Uploads stream to disk to avoid large-file memory spikes, and invalid workbooks now return clear user-facing errors.
History deletion validates run IDs, corrupt history indexes rebuild from saved runs, and bad user plugin manifests no longer block plugin scanning.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
